sloka: प्लवे कठिनकाजम् च रामश्चक्रे सहायुधैः ।आरोप्य प्रथमम् सीताम् सम्घाटम् प्रतिगृह्य तौ ॥२-५५-१८॥
transliteration: plave kaṭhinakājam ca rāmaścakre sahāyudhaiḥ ।āropya prathamam sītām samghāṭam pratigṛhya tau ॥2-55-18॥

translations.english: Those valiant sons of Dasaratha held the float (firmly) to help Sita step on to it. Then they crossed the river carefully.
